Gmsh could not build prism order 3, and hexahedron, pyramid and mixed order 10 (see build errors in raw/), so those cells are absent.  legacy_conflicts lists cells where the writer rules refuse and the read-back succeeded; the read-back counts elements and cannot show an element order or Plot3D block survived, so the writer rule stays (the matrix only tightens).  A cell with no entry was not measured and is judged by the writer limits of export_writers.WRITERS.
